Name: FS - Harry's Short Hair
Author: eunomicZenith
Description:
Short hairstyles seem to be pretty scarce, both in the vanilla game and in existing mods! So I made my own.

See the media for pictures of the hairstyles within!

This mod is a content pack for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9969]Fashion Sense[/url] and will do nothing on its own! (Which, in turn, requires SMAPI.) Ensure you have both Fashion Sense and SMAPI installed.

[size=5]Install[/size]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font]
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]

Downloads.Description: Content pack of short hairstyles for use with Fashion Sense.
